item.title: Gilbane tops out USC School of Medicine building in Columbia
item.description: Gilbane has topped out USC’s $300 million School of Medicine building in Columbia’s BullStreet District, marking a major milestone for the health sciences project. The post Gilbane tops out USC School of Medicine building in Columbia appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Huntington Bank expands in the Carolinas under Trent Holland
item.description: Trent Holland leads Huntington Bank’s expansion across North and South Carolina, opening 55 branches and supporting local communities and businesses. The post Huntington Bank expands in the Carolinas under Trent Holland appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Smalls Sliders to open 5 locations across Upstate
item.description: Smalls Sliders, backed by Drew Brees, plans five new Upstate locations under a multi-unit deal led by Feather & Fries LLC in Spartanburg and Greenville. The post Smalls Sliders to open 5 locations across Upstate appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Breeze Airways adds nonstop Charleston to Atlantic City
item.description: Breeze Airways will launch nonstop service from Charleston to Atlantic City starting May 6, with twice-weekly flights and a special offer beginning at $49 one way. The post Breeze Airways adds nonstop Charleston to Atlantic City appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Breeze Airways adds nonstop GSP to Columbus route
item.description: Breeze Airways will launch nonstop flights from Greenville-Spartanburg International Airport to Columbus, Ohio, starting May 8 with $49 introductory fares. The post Breeze Airways adds nonstop GSP to Columbus route appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Superbox launces US operations with Charleston headquarters
item.description: Dawsongroup tcs USA launches Superbox, a modular cold chain system, in Charleston, leveraging the Port of Charleston to serve U.S. food and pharma supply chains. The post Superbox launces US operations with Charleston headquarters appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Airline resumes nonstop Columbia to Chicago flights
item.description: American Airlines will restart nonstop service from Columbia Metropolitan Airport to Chi-cago O’Hare on May 21 with twice-daily flights using an Embraer 170. The post Airline resumes nonstop Columbia to Chicago flights appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: UNDER CONSTRUCTION: Commercial projects rising across South Carolina
item.description: From industrial and distribution centers to fire stations and office upfits, explore recent and ongoing commercial construction projects across South Carolina. The post UNDER CONSTRUCTION: Commercial projects rising across South Carolina appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Goodwill opens attended donation center in Anderson
item.description: Goodwill Industries opens a new attended donation center in Anderson, expanding Upstate services that fund job training, career education and workforce programs. The post Goodwill opens attended donation center in Anderson appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: MUSC Health opens Clements Ferry Pavilion
item.description: MUSC has opened its 80,000-square-foot Clements Ferry Pavilion, expanding access to health care services in Charleston and Berkeley counties. The post MUSC Health opens Clements Ferry Pavilion appeared first on SCBiz.
